# Dashboard Documentation — `11_powerbi/CustomerSegmentation.pbip`

**Format.** Power BI Project (PBIP): semantic model in TMDL, report in PBIR — plain-text, diffable, generated by
`11_powerbi/build_pbip.py`. **Connection:** DirectQuery to PostgreSQL `localhost:5435`, database `custsegdb`,
schema `pbi` (user/password `custseg`/`custseg`, asked once by Power BI Desktop). Canvas 1280 × 800.

## Pages

| # | Page | Content | Filters / interaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Executive Customer Overview | KPI cards (purchasing, active, new customers, revenue, AOV, repeat rate), monthly revenue trend, new vs returning customers per month, customers and revenue contribution by segment | month, region, state, segment, category slicers; segment tooltip |
| 2 | Customer Segmentation Analysis | segment KPIs, customers / revenue by segment, RFM score distribution, Recency × Frequency and Frequency × Monetary bubble charts, segment performance matrix | segment, region, buyer type, E1 RFM segment; **drill-through** to Customer Details |
| 3 | Customer Value & CLV | historical / predicted CLV, top-10 / top-20 % revenue share, CLV band histogram, revenue Pareto curve, top-10 customers (responds to slicers), spend & AOV by segment, predicted-CLV tiers | global slicers |
| 4 | Customer Retention & Churn | 3-month retention & churn, repeat rate, reactivated, inactive share, active; **cohort retention heatmap** (conditional colours), churn by segment, inactivity distribution, retention/reactivation trend | segment, region, cohort |
| 5 | Customer Purchasing Behavior | frequency, purchase interval, basket size, AOV, installments, review; frequency trend, day-of-week, hour-of-day, category preference, association rules, category × segment cross-sell map | global slicers |
| 6 | Marketing & Business Strategy | high-value at-risk & high-potential counts and value, segment opportunity matrix, high-value at-risk list, high-potential list, segment size change vs 6 months earlier, recommended strategy per segment, campaign-data note | – |
| – | Customer Details | drill-through target: segment KPIs, customer list (pseudonymous codes), customers by state | drill-through on `segment_name` |
| – | Segment tooltip | customers, % revenue, AOV, inactive share for the hovered segment | report-page tooltip on segment visuals |
| – | Appendix | stage-2 model comparison, KPI dictionary (definitions, formulas, baselines, targets, owners) | – |

## Design rules applied (PRD 10.4)

- **Currency: Rupiah** (fixed Rp 4.026/BRL, see design_principles.md) with Indonesian-formatted KPI cards.
- "Charcoal & Coral" theme (details: `11_powerbi/dashboard_design/design_principles.md`): one validated colour per
  segment — At Risk coral, Hibernating orchid, New teal, Loyal indigo — identical in every visual and in the Python
  figures; denim / amber-gold for non-segment series; indigo ramp for the cohort heatmap.
- Status colour (red) only for churn.
- Header band shows the data date and the refresh timestamp (`[Data As Of]`).
- KPI definitions are on the appendix page; every KPI card label states its definition window (e.g. "≤ T days").
- Performance: facts expose only revenue rows; cohort, retention, affinity, Pareto and profiles are
  pre-aggregated tables; no high-cardinality columns are used on axes except in the customer tables.

## Validation

`python 11_powerbi/validate_measures.py` (with the PBIP open) runs every measure through the Desktop's local
Analysis Services engine and compares it to SQL → `11_powerbi/dax_measures/measure_validation.md`
(this run: 78 measures incl. 27 Indonesian label measures, 0 errors, 22 KPI measures identical to SQL × FX rate,
segment breakdown and category-filter propagation identical).

## Privacy (PRD 12.3)

The `pbi` views never expose `customer_unique_id`, `customer_id`, zip codes or individual coordinates; customers appear
as `customer_code` (C000001…). Location is aggregated to city/state.
